preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(n.is_integer() and 2 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 and n % 2 == 0 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('t')])
preconditions.description: Each test case has an even integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 2e5) representing the number of dominoes.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('t') and not line.startswith(str(n)))
preconditions.description: Each domino is represented by two integers a_i and b_i (1 ≤ a_i, b_i ≤ n).

postconditions.description: The output for each test case is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i] == 'YES') == (can_divide_dominoes(dominoes)) for i, dominoes in enumerate(parse_test_cases(stdin)) if i % (n + 1) == 0)
postconditions.description: For each test case, 'YES' is printed if and only if the dominoes can be divided into two sets where all numbers in each set are distinct.
